titles: Shift Garlic & Herb Chicken Proper Pasta
method: The listed wholewheat pasta quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.
Bring a saucepan of water to the boil. The 75g wholewheat pasta, dry is a dry weight: cook according to its packet until tender, then drain, saving a small cup of pasta water.
Dice the courgette, cherry tomatoes into bite-size pieces. Stir together the measured light mayonnaise, garlic powder, dried parsley in a small bowl and keep this dressing chilled until serving.

Heat half the measured olive oil in a non-stick frying pan. Cut the chicken breast into even 2cm pieces. Fry over medium-high heat for about 8–12 minutes, turning regularly. Cook until no pink remains inside and the pieces are steaming hot throughout; a clean thermometer should read 75°C for 30 seconds at the centre. Transfer the cooked filling to a clean plate.
Add the remaining measured olive oil and courgette, cherry tomatoes to the pan. Cook over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, stirring until the courgette softens and the tomatoes release their juices.

Add the cooked pasta and filling. Take the pan off the heat before folding through the light mayonnaise, garlic powder, dried parsley dressing; do not boil it. Toss gently, using another spoonful of reserved pasta water if it needs loosening. Serve immediately.
